newsitem.title: USA: US Mid-Atlantic daily power softens on milder temp.
newsitem.headline: US Mid-Atlantic daily power softens on milder temp.

text.p: Day-ahead bulk electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. softened Thursday on revised weather forecasts, which called for higher-than-expected temperatures in the region Friday.
"The weather revisions pumped up the temperatures by five degrees (F)," noted one power trader.

The latest forecasts show the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect district will have near normal temperatures through most of Saturday before readings drop to six to 12 degrees below normal Saturday night through Sunday.
Firm, peak PJM electricity for Friday (excluding transmission costs) were traded in a $30.00-$31.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) range, tighter than Wednesday's $30.00-$32.00 for delivery today.
Firm, off-peak PJM for Friday held at $15.00-$17.00.
Early discussion for PJM deliveries next week was pegged at $29.80-$30.50.
Short-term power purchase rose this week with scheduled outage of the 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear power unit later today, market sources said.
The Pottsdam, Pa., generating unit, which was running at roughly 74 percent power, is expected to be taken off line for a 25-day refueling and maintenance program.
Most forward PJM prices were steady to slightly higher today in tandem with steady natural gas futures, brokers and traders said.
As of 1223 EST, NYMEX March Henry Hub gas futures were down 0.8 cents to $2.435.
Swing gas prices at the Philadelphia city gate were notionally valued near $4.10 per million British thermal units, a touch higher than Wednesday's $4.00.
February PJM electricity strengthened to $29.50-$29.85 from Wednesday's $29.40-$29.60 amid light activity.
March PJM power was quoted at $24.30-$24.50, a little higher than $24.25-$24.45 Wednesday..
PJM deliveries for April and May widened slightly to $22.00-$22.25 from Wednesday's $22.00-$22.20.
June power prices in PJM widened to $24.90-$25.25 from $25.00-$25.15 Wednesday.
July/August PJM deliveries rose to $30.15-$30.45 from Wednesday's $30.00-$30.20.
PJM electricity for the third-quarter was steady at $27.75-$28.00, while fourth-quarter PJM rebounded to $23.85-$24.10 from Wednesday's $23.75-$24.00.
Calendar 1998 PJM electricity for firm, peak delivery weekdays were assessed at $25.60-$26.00.
